interactionSummary: The clearest favorable pattern was that frame interaction with the cheeks leaned favorable (8 positive versus 0 negative reports).
The clearest caution was that headgear interaction with the neck leaned unfavorable (0 positive versus 5 negative reports).

interactionInsights.label: Frame at Cheeks: Face Marks

positiveEvidence.text: No more plastic frame extending along my cheeks to shift and mark me

interactionInsights.description: Reports about the frame where it contacts the cheeks were mostly favorable for avoiding facial marks: 8 positive, 0 mixed, and 0 negative across 8 reviews. This isolates a component-to-body interaction rather than general mask satisfaction.

methodology.overallScore: 60% normalized original reviewer star rating and 40% extracted overall-satisfaction sentiment. Both components require at least five reviews.
methodology.aggregation: Repeated claims are averaged within each review before review-level results are combined.
methodology.minimumEvidence: Findings require at least five distinct reviews.
methodology.limitations: Retailer reviews are self-selected and may not represent every CPAP patient. Text findings were extracted by an AI model and are not medical advice.
